title: Are you at the Mallworld school and missing something?
content: I had a very long and VERY lucid MW dream last night. This is going to sound strange. If you are searching through the Mallworld school and are missing a binder and a set of DVDs or data disks, I left them in the study room behind the main classroom near the bathrooms on the ground floor. The binder is on the desk at the back of the room. The side entrance off the park where the festival is going on is the best way to get there if you want to avoid the main entrance.
